caseName: Harris County Appraisal District v. Transamerica Container Leasing, Inc.
caseNameFull: Harris County Appraisal District v. Transamerica Container Leasing, Inc.

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Tex., 1st Dist. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Itel Containers Int’l Corp. v. Huddleston, ante, p. 60.

Justice Stevens would deny certio-rari.
